about: The counter tray, made by tools/tray/build_tray.py from tools/tray/tray.json. The tray's own frame, in h: x along its length, y across, z up from its underside. Triangles are wound as Blender has them (counter-clockwise seen from outside, in a right-handed frame); uv (0, 0) is the picture's bottom left.
